about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Leader in LED Lighting Technology and Energy Saving Solutions
about.profile_desc1: VCOMM DIGITAL (THAILAND) CO.,LTD. (VCOMM) was established in 2017 with a vision to be a leader in lighting innovation and automated control systems. We focus on developing technologies that enhance energy management efficiency for our clients.
about.profile_desc2: We offer high-quality products covering all needs, from LED bulbs for commercial buildings, industrial factories, warehouses, to public lighting and street lights.
about.tech_intro: VCOMM has created numerous excellent innovations in Automation and Intelligent Control, propelling us to become a leading lighting technology company.
about.tech_desc: We use the IES Integrated Energy Management System, which we developed in-house, to analyze and manage energy consumption precisely:
about.tech_list2: Optimizing energy usage of Central Air Conditioning Systems
about.tech_outro: Our system helps customers discover energy issues in advance and take prompt corrective actions, which is key to reducing environmental impact.
about.proof_desc: Our mission is to create maximum value for customers by reducing energy consumption by 20%-80% through our solutions. We are trusted by many leading clients across various industries in Thailand.
about.vision_desc: To be the leading Smart Ecological Lighting Solution Provider, driving Thai businesses towards sustainability with clean energy and smart technology.
